segments.html:
App [ on: boolean = false,
    onMouseDown() { on = !on },
    group: View [ x = center, y = center, width = 80%, height = { this.contentHeight },
        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 20 ],
        Text [ width = { parent.width }, textAlign = center, textColor = slategray, text = "click anywhere to toggle" ],
        lane: View [ width = { parent.width }, height = 60,
            ball: View [ y = center, height = 60, width = 60, cornerRadius = 30, fill = dodgerblue,
                Spring [ attribute = x, to = { on ? lane.width - ball.width : 0 },
                    stiffness = 190, damping = 20 ]
                ]
            ]
        ]
    ]
